name: Entire Wheat Bread
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: ¼ cup sugar or ⅓ cup molasses
ingredients.originalText: ¼ cup sugar or ⅓ cup molasses

ingredients.name: yeast cake dissolved in ¼ cup lukewarm water
ingredients.originalText: 1 yeast cake dissolved in ¼ cup lukewarm water

instructions.text: Add sweetening and salt to milk; cool, and when lukewarm add dissolved yeast cake and flour
Beat well, cover, and let rise to double its bulk
Again beat, and turn into greased bread pans, having pans one-half full
Entire Wheat Bread should not quite double its bulk during last rising
This mixture may be baked in gem pans

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Add sweetening and salt to milk; cool, and when lukewarm add dissolved yeast cake and flour
2. Beat well, cover, and let rise to double its bulk
3. Again beat, and turn into greased bread pans, having pans one-half full
4. Let rise, and bake
5. Entire Wheat Bread should not quite double its bulk during last rising
6. This mixture may be baked in gem pans

1 yeast cake dissolved in ¼ cup lukewarm water
